item_nhx_staffstorms_description: The power of Thor, stolen and corrupted by Hel. The storm answers its bearer.
item_nhx_staffmuspelheim_description: A shard of the fire that burns in Surtr's realm, bound in steel. Muspelheim's anger has not cooled.
item_nhx_stormcaller_hood_description: Stormcaller's Raiment. Under the hood, two eyes glow like distant lightning.
item_nhx_stormcaller_robe_description: Stormcaller's Raiment. Storm-dyed robes around a crystal that hums with thunder.
item_nhx_stormcaller_greaves_description: Stormcaller's Raiment. Steel-shod legwraps for walking the storm's path.
item_nhx_stormcaller_cloak_description: Stormcaller's Raiment. It billows in winds that aren't there.
item_nhx_firecaller_hood_description: Firecaller's Regalia. Under the hood, two embers stare back.
item_nhx_firecaller_robe_description: Firecaller's Regalia. Robes dyed in Muspelheim's glow, around a crystal that never cools.
item_nhx_firecaller_greaves_description: Firecaller's Regalia. Steel-shod legwraps that have walked through fire.
item_nhx_firecaller_cloak_description: Firecaller's Regalia. It ripples like heat above embers.
se_nhx_firecaller_tooltip: Unleashes the full power of Muspelheim
se_nhx_perlevel: per level of the least upgraded piece
se_nhx_stormcaller_tooltip: Commands the full fury of the storm
se_nhx_firecaller_weakness: Each hit of the Wrath of Muspelheim lowers fire resistance one more step, down to very weak, for
se_nhx_stormcaller_weakness: Each hit of the Staff of Storms lowers lightning resistance one more step, down to very weak, for
se_nhx_static_tooltip: The storm gathers on whoever wields the Staff of Storms against the twins. Each charge slows your eitr's return by a fifth; at the last, the storm breaks upon you, harder each time you hold on. Taking up the Wrath of Muspelheim clears it.
se_nhx_scorch_tooltip: Muspelheim's heat gathers on whoever wields its Wrath against the twins. Each charge slows your stamina's return by a fifth; at the last, it engulfs you, harder each time you hold on. Taking up the Staff of Storms clears it.
msg_nhx_twin_fell_storm: The Stormcaller falls! Slay the Firecaller before it raises its twin.
msg_nhx_twin_fell_fire: The Firecaller falls! Slay the Stormcaller before it raises its twin.
msg_nhx_twins_withdraw: The elements withdraw. Their twins are gone.
msg_nhx_judgment_warning: The elements are watching. Wield only their gifts.
msg_nhx_judged: The elements have judged you and found you wanting.
msg_nhx_judged_other: has been deemed unworthy by the elements.
msg_nhx_arena_warning: Return to the circle! The elements are watching.
item_nhx_stormheart_description: The Stormcaller's heart, still humming with the storm that filled its empty robes. Stormcaller's Raiment is woven around one.
item_nhx_surtrstear_description: Wept by the Firecaller as it fell, a tear of Muspelheim's fire that never cools. The Firecaller's Regalia is forged around one.
item_nhx_lodestone_description: A thunder stone bound to a surtling core. It pulls toward the altars of the elements: use it to find the nearest, and offer it there to call the twins.
msg_nhx_lodestone_pull: The lodestone pulls toward the nearest altar of the elements.
msg_nhx_lodestone_none: The lodestone stays still: no altar of the elements answers.
msg_nhx_altar_offer: Offer a Lodestone of the Elements to call the twins.
